title: Algorithm Plugin Input Arguments
description: A schema for algorithm plugin input arguments

class_names.title: Class Names
class_names.description: Comma-separated class names, a single number for class count, or leave blank to infer from the model.

aug_library.title: Augmentation Library Name
aug_library.description: Indicate the augmentation library to extract from (default and only available library: albumentations)

aug_methods.title: Augmentation Method(s) Name
aug_methods.description: Indicate the augmentation functions separated by commas (default: all)

custom_parameters.title: Custom Parameters
custom_parameters.description: Custom parameters for the augmentation_method(s) (default for no custom params: None)
